podcast.title: Thirty seconds of fame

hosts.Leyla: lives in Baku and loves a good plan
hosts.Sam: grew up in Manchester and once travelled with no plan at all

before.predict: How many hours a day do you spend on social media? Guess: whose video went viral — Leyla's or Sam's?

lines.t: Hi everyone, and welcome to the SpeakLab Podcast. I'm Leyla.
And I'm Sam. Today's topic is social media — and Leyla is a little bit famous now.
[laugh] Stop it. Only for one week.
Tell everyone what happened.
I filmed my cat, Pişik, pushing a birthday cake off the table. I posted it, went to sleep, and in the morning it was viral. Two million views!
Two million! You were in the spotlight.
It was so strange. My phone didn't stop. Brands wrote to me. Someone asked if Pişik wanted to be an influencer.
[chuckle] And did she say yes?
She said nothing, she's a cat. But I learned a lot about how the algorithm works. It loves engagement — likes, comments, shares.
Right. The more people react, the more people see it in their feed.
But it wasn't all nice. Some comments were really rude. One troll wrote that I'm a terrible owner.
Oh no. What did you do?
At first I wanted to answer. But an answer would only stir up more anger. So I just used the block button.
Good choice. And I think many people now jump on the bandwagon — they copy every trend just to get likes.
Yes, and they feel bad when the numbers are low. Social media can be fun, but it can also make us anxious.
I agree. I checked my screen time last month. Five hours a day. [sigh] Five!
That's a lot of hours. What did you change?
I turned off notifications, and my phone sleeps in the kitchen at night. I read more now.
Nice. My rule: no phone for the first hour of the day.
Hard, but good. Use social media — don't let it use you.
Here's your question for your next SpeakLab call: what do you love and what do you hate about social media?
And send us your cat videos. See you next time!
[laugh] Bye for now!

questions.q: What is the episode mainly about?
options: The good and bad sides of social media
questions.why: Leyla's viral video, the algorithm, trolls and screen time.

questions.why: That was last month; he has changed his habits since.
"They copy every trend just to get likes."
